name: Comfy Cloud
original_description: Comfy Cloud lets you create images, video, audio and 3D assets on Comfy's hosted GPUs from a conversation. Generate directly with partner models such as Flux, Kling, ByteDance and ElevenLabs, or run any of Comfy's published workflow templates for text-to-image, image-to-video, upscaling, style transfer and more. You can search the model and template catalogs, estimate a run's credit cost before spending, and run the workflows saved in your Comfy Cloud workspace. Each run returns a link to the finished file, and paid generations ask for your confirmation before any credits are spent. Sign in with your Comfy account to connect.
